title: WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.65 at DEPTH=10
description: Increased WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.65 (longer LR cooldown, less time at peak LR), all else unchanged from the DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.003021, essentially flat/slightly worse than the 1.002530 baseline. Combined with round 0's finding that WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.3 was also worse (at the old depth=8 baseline), this brackets WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.5 as a local optimum from both directions -- the schedule-shape axis via WARMDOWN_RATIO alone looks exhausted. I deliberately switched away from the WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 idea I originally proposed since a2 proposed the identical change this round; no need to duplicate that run.
